description: This file defines a React component for displaying recipe details, along with loader and meta functions for server-side data fetching and metadata. It imports data access functions, React hooks, and routing components, indicating it’s part of a Remix-run-based web app for displaying recipes.

methods.name: meta
methods.description: Specifies metadata for the page, such as title and description, based on the recipe data.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Fetches recipe data by ID from the route parameters for server-side rendering.

methods.name: RecipeDetail
methods.description: React component rendering detailed view of a recipe including ingredients, steps, and tags.

methods.name: ErrorBoundary
methods.description: UI to display when an error occurs during data loading or rendering.
